name: eBay (US, via GPUDojo tracker) price page for nvidia-tesla-p40
notes: GPUDojo lowest used eBay offer $349, 'near 90-day high'; eBay ask excludes shipping. GPUDojo's own used-market panel (15 listings, 11 sellers, observed 2026-10-18) gives typical asking $384, middle-50% $354-421, full range $270-510 — so $345-384 is the realistic used street band, and the single $349 eBay offer is the cheapest tracked.
